method.scope: Regular-season games through Week 3 that entered the ratings (249 games), all opponents, all quarters
method.plays: Rush and pass plays (sacks and interceptions count as passes), downs 1-4; kneels, spikes, penalties and no-plays excluded
method.success: Gain of at least 50% of the distance on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd and 4th
method.ranks: Among FBS teams; 1 = best. Defense: lower EPA allowed is better
